verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a Postgres endpoint aimed at "BI tools, any Postgres client" that works with no DuckDB install, so standard Postgres-compatible tools can connect without custom glue. It also lists a Java SDK among its official SDKs. However, the pack never names JDBC or ODBC drivers explicitly and shows no documented integrations with specific BI tools. Missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, named BI-tool integration guides (e.g. specific dashboard tools), independent or hands-on corroboration of BI connectivity.
